title: Sparkwater Port

[[Image:Sparkwater Port.png|thumb|300px]]
'''Sparkwater Port''' is a harbor located on the eastern coast of [[Durotar]]. It stands as a bold testament to the [[Durotar Labor Union]]'s rise within the Horde, where the fires of industry blaze brightly as goblins forge their fortunes along the shore.
